name: Ocular Miracle
tagline: A planet, a red nebula, and the calmest art on this list.

facts.note: Too large to ship as one level. Davphla reworked it into three separate extremes — Reverie, Faith and Diligence — uploaded on 27 June 2020 to GaidenHertuny's, ZeroSR's and Davphla's accounts respectively, and all rated on 30 June 2020.

spotlight.eyebrow: Too large to ship as one level
spotlight.sub: Reverie, Faith and Diligence — uploaded across three accounts on the same day so the game could load it at all.

voice.hook: The magnum opus of the Geometry Dash editor.
voice.why:
Ocular Miracle is the magnum opus of the Geometry Dash editor. Davphla and the team pushed the game's engine to the absolute breaking point, packing in so much stunning, hyper-detailed art that the level literally had to be split into three separate extremes — Reverie, Faith and Diligence — just so people could play it without their games crashing.

It is a sensory explosion of colour, cinematic transitions and breathtaking effects, serving as a monument to what the community's artists can achieve when they completely ignore technical limitations.
